(&quot;Versant&quot;) Class A common stock, par value $0.01 per share (&quot;Versant Class A Common Stock&quot;) and Versant Class B common stock, par value $0.01 per share (&quot;Versant Class B Common Stock&quot;) to the holders of record of Comcast Class A common stock, par value $0.01 per share (&quot;Comcast Class A Common Stock&quot;) and Comcast Class B common stock, par value $0.01 per share (&quot;Comcast Class B Common Stock&quot;), respectively, as of December 16, 2025, the record date for the Distribution (&quot;Record Date&quot;).</footnote> <footnote id="F2">In connection with the Distribution, pursuant to (i) the terms of the Employee Matters Agreement, dated as of January 2, 2026, by and between Comcast and Versant (&quot;EMA&quot;) and (ii) the anti-dilution adjustment provisions under the Comcast 2002 Restricted Stock Plan and Comcast 2023 Omnibus Equity Incentive Plan, certain restricted stock units with respect to Comcast Class A Common Stock (&quot;Comcast RSUs&quot;) were equitably adjusted and converted into restricted stock units with respect to Versant Class A Common Stock (&quot;Versant RSUs&quot;), based on (i) the volume weighted average price of Comcast Class A Common Stock (adjusted based on the Distribution ratio) and Versant Class A Common Stock, in each case for the five trading-day period following January 2, 2026 (such adjustment, the &quot;Equity Award Conversion&quot;).</footnote> <footnote id="F3">Represents the grant of Versant RSUs upon the conversion of certain Comcast RSUs held by the Reporting Person as of January 2, 2026 pursuant to the Equity Award Conversion. The Versant RSUs were granted pursuant to the Versant Omnibus Equity Incentive Plan (&quot;Versant Plan&quot;) and are generally subject to the same terms and conditions as applicable to the corresponding Comcast RSUs.</footnote> <footnote id="F4">This amount includes shares of Versant Class A Common Stock received by the Reporting Person in connection with the Distribution in respect of shares of Comcast Class A Common Stock held as of the Record Date.</footnote> <footnote id="F5">Represents the grant of a Versant RSU award (&quot;Founder's Grant&quot;) under the Versant Plan to the Reporting Person on January 9, 2026. The Founder's Grant will vest in full on the third anniversary of the date of grant, subject to the Reporting Person's continued employment through such date.</footnote> </footnotes> <ownerSignature> <signatureName>/s/ Jordan Fasbender, as attorney-in-fact</signatureName> <signatureDate>2026-01-12</signatureDate> </ownerSignature> </ownershipDocument>

(&quot;Versant&quot;) Class A common stock, par value $0.01 per share (&quot;Versant Class A Common Stock&quot;) and Versant Class B common stock, par value $0.01 per share (&quot;Versant Class B Common Stock&quot;) to the holders of record of Comcast Class A common stock, par value $0.01 per share (&quot;Comcast Class A Common Stock&quot;) and Comcast Class B common stock, par value $0.01 per share (&quot;Comcast Class B Common Stock&quot;), respectively, as of December 16, 2025, the record date for the Distribution (&quot;Record Date&quot;).</footnote> <footnote id="F2">In connection with the Distribution, pursuant to (i) the terms of the Employee Matters Agreement, dated as of January 2, 2026, by and between Comcast and Versant (&quot;EMA&quot;) and (ii) the anti-dilution adjustment provisions under the Comcast 2002 Restricted Stock Plan and Comcast 2023 Omnibus Equity Incentive Plan, certain restricted stock units with respect to Comcast Class A Common Stock (&quot;Comcast RSUs&quot;) were equitably adjusted and converted into restricted stock units with respect to Versant Class A Common Stock (&quot;Versant RSUs&quot;), based on (i) the volume weighted average price of Comcast Class A Common Stock (adjusted based on the Distribution ratio) and Versant Class A Common Stock, in each case for the five trading-day period following January 2, 2026 (such adjustment, the &quot;Equity Award Conversion&quot;).</footnote> <footnote id="F3">Represents the grant of Versant RSUs upon the conversion of certain Comcast RSUs held by the Reporting Person as of January 2, 2026 pursuant to the Equity Award Conversion. The Versant RSUs were granted pursuant to the Versant Omnibus Equity Incentive Plan (&quot;Versant Plan&quot;) and are generally subject to the same terms and conditions as applicable to the corresponding Comcast RSUs.</footnote> <footnote id="F4">This amount includes shares of Versant Class A Common Stock received by the Reporting Person in connection with the Distribution in respect of shares of Comcast Class A Common Stock held as of the Record Date.</footnote> <footnote id="F5">Represents the grant of a Versant RSU award (&quot;Founder's Grant&quot;) under the Versant Plan to the Reporting Person on January 9, 2026. The Founder's Grant will vest in full on the third anniversary of the date of grant, subject to the Reporting Person's continued employment through such date.</footnote> </footnotes> <ownerSignature> <signatureName>/s/ Jordan Fasbender, as attorney-in-fact</signatureName> <signatureDate>2026-01-12</signatureDate> </ownerSignature> </ownershipDocument>

</derivativeTable> <footnotes> <footnote id="F1">On June 29, 2026, Honeywell International Inc. (&quot;Honeywell&quot;) distributed a pro rata dividend to Honeywell shareowners of one share of common stock, par value $0.01 per share (&quot;HONA Common Stock&quot;), of Honeywell Aerospace Inc., a Delaware corporation (&quot;HONA&quot;), for every two shares of Honeywell common stock, par value $1.00 per share, held by each holder of record as of the close of business on June 15, 2026, to effect the previously announced spin-off of HONA from Honeywell.</footnote> <footnote id="F2">HONA Common Stock held indirectly by the reporting person in the Honeywell Aerospace 401(k) Plan will be voluntarily reported following the Honeywell Aerospace 401(k) Plan blackout period.</footnote> <footnote id="F3">Instrument converts to HONA Common stock on a one-for-one basis.</footnote> <footnote id="F4">Performance stock units that were received by the reporting person when the reporting person was employed by Honeywell, 50% of which vested upon the successful completion of the spin-off of HONA from Honeywell on June 29, 2026 and 50% of which will vest on June 29, 2027, and were converted into restricted stock units of HONA Common Stock in accordance with the Employee Matters Agreement, dated July 29, 2026 between Honeywell and HONA.</footnote> <footnote id="F5">Excludes reinvestment of dividend equivalents during the vesting period.</footnote> <footnote id="F6">Represents equity awards originally granted by Honeywell that have been adjusted or converted into equity awards of HONA in connection with the spin-off of HONA from Honeywell in accordance with the Employee Matters Agreement, dated July 29, 2026, between HONA and Honeywell.</footnote> <footnote id="F7">The restricted stock units will vest on July 30, 2026.</footnote> <footnote id="F8">The restricted stock units will vest on March 1, 2027.</footnote> <footnote id="F9">33% of the restricted stock units will vest on August 1, 2026, 33% of the restricted stock units will vest on August 1, 2027 and 34% of the restricted stock units will vest on August 1, 2028.</footnote> <footnote id="F10">The restricted stock units will vest on March 3, 2028.</footnote> <footnote id="F11">33% of the restricted stock units will vest on February 23, 2027, 33% of the restricted stock units will vest on February 23, 2028 and 34% of the restricted stock units will vest on February 23, 2029.</footnote> <footnote id="F12">The employee stock options are fully vested.</footnote> <footnote id="F13">75% of the employee stock options are fully vested and 25% of the employee stock options will vest on February 23, 2027.</footnote> <footnote id="F14">50% of the employee stock options are fully vested and 25% of the employee stock options will vest on each of March 1, 2027 and March 1, 2028, respectively.</footnote> <footnote id="F15">25% of the employee stock options are fully vested and 25% of the employee stock options will vest on each of March 3, 2027, March 3, 2028 and March 3, 2029, respectively.</footnote> <footnote id="F16">The employee stock options will vest on February 23, 2029.</footnote> </footnotes> <remarks></remarks> <ownerSignature> <signatureName>/s/ Jennifer Nelson for Karen Elizabeth Arlak</signatureName> <signatureDate>2026-07-01</signatureDate> </ownerSignature> </ownershipDocument>

(&quot;Honeywell&quot;) distributed a pro rata dividend to Honeywell shareowners of one share of common stock, par value $0.01 per share (&quot;HONA Common Stock&quot;), of Honeywell Aerospace Inc., a Delaware corporation (&quot;HONA&quot;), for every two shares of Honeywell common stock, par value $1.00 per share, held by each holder of record as of the close of business on June 15, 2026, to effect the previously announced spin-off of HONA from Honeywell.</footnote> <footnote id="F2">HONA Common Stock held indirectly by the reporting person in the Honeywell Aerospace 401(k) Plan will be voluntarily reported following the Honeywell Aerospace 401(k) Plan blackout period.</footnote> <footnote id="F3">Instrument converts to HONA Common Stock on a one-for-one basis.</footnote> <footnote id="F4">Performance stock units that were received by the reporting person when the reporting person was employed by Honeywell, which were converted into HONA restricted stock units in connection with the spin-off of HONA from Honeywell in accordance with the Employee Matters Agreement, dated July 29, 2026 between the HONA and Honeywell.</footnote> <footnote id="F5">Excludes reinvestment of dividend equivalents during the vesting period.</footnote> <footnote id="F6">The restricted stock units will vest on February 16, 2027.</footnote> <footnote id="F7">Performance stock units that were received by the reporting person when the reporting person was employed by Honeywell, 50% of which vested upon the successful completion of the spin-off of HONA from Honeywell on June 29, 2026 and 50% of which will vest on June 29, 2027, and were converted into restricted stock units of HONA Common Stock in accordance with the Employee Matters Agreement, dated July 29, 2026 between Honeywell and HONA.</footnote> <footnote id="F8">Represents equity awards originally granted by Honeywell that have been adjusted or converted into equity awards of HONA in connection with the spin-off of HONA from Honeywell in accordance with the Employee Matters Agreement, dated July 29, 2026, between HONA and Honeywell.</footnote> <footnote id="F9">The restricted stock units will vest on July 30, 2026.</footnote> <footnote id="F10">The restricted stock units will vest on February 11, 2027.</footnote> <footnote id="F11">49% of the restricted stock units will vest on August 1, 2026 and 51% of the restricted stock units will vest on August 1, 2027.</footnote> <footnote id="F12">49% of the restricted stock units will vest on February 16, 2027 and 51% of the restricted stock units will vest on February 16, 2028.</footnote> <footnote id="F13">33% of the restricted stock units will vest on February 19, 2027, 33% of the restricted stock units will vest on February 19, 2028 and 34% of the restricted stock units will vest on February 19, 2029.</footnote> <footnote id="F14">25% of the restricted stock units will vest on each of February 19, 2027, February 19, 2028, February 19, 2029 and February 19, 2030, respectively.</footnote> <footnote id="F15">Employee stock options granted by Honeywell when the reporting person was employed by Honeywell subject to successful completion of the spin-off of HONA from Honeywell, which were converted into options for HONA Common Stock with 50% vested on June 29, 2026 and 50% vesting on June 29, 2027 in accordance with the Employee Matters Agreement, dated July 29, 2026 between Honeywell and HONA.</footnote> <footnote id="F16">The employee stock options are fully vested.</footnote> <footnote id="F17">64% of the employee stock options are fully vested and 33% of the employee stock options will vest on February 23, 2027.</footnote> <footnote id="F18">50% of the employee stock options are fully vested and 25% of the employee stock options will vest on each of August 1, 2026 and August 1, 2027, respectively.</footnote> <footnote id="F19">50% of the employee stock options are fully vested and 25% of the employee stock options will vest on each of February 16, 2027 and February 16, 2028, respectively.</footnote> <footnote id="F20">25% of the employee stock options are fully vested and 25% of the employee stock options will vest on each of February 19, 2027, February 19, 2028 and February 19, 2029, respectively.</footnote> <footnote id="F21">The employee stock options will vest on February 19, 2030.</footnote> Pursuant to an amended and restated certificate of incorporation of HONA filed with the Secretary of State of the State of Delaware on June 24, 2026, the 19,715 shares of HONA Common Stock were automatically converted into an aggregate of 316,939,750 shares of HONA Common Stock (the &quot;Recapitalization&quot;). The Recapitalization was exempt pursuant to Rules 16a-9 and 16b-7 under the Exchange Act and did not result in a change in the pecuniary interest of Honeywell in HONA.</footnote> </footnotes> <remarks></remarks> <ownerSignature> <signatureName>/s/ Richard E. (&quot;S&amp;P Global&quot;) completed a pro-rata spinoff distribution (&quot;Spin-Off&quot;) of all of its shares of Issuer common stock to the holders of record of S&amp;P Global's common stock on June 15, 2026 (the &quot;Record Date&quot;).</footnote> <footnote id="F2">In connection with the Spin-Off, pursuant to the terms of the Employee Matters Agreement, dated as of June 30, 2026, by and between S&amp;P Global and the Issuer and the anti-dilution adjustment provisions under the applicable S&amp;P Global equity incentive plans, certain restricted stock units and performance-based restricted stock units with respect to S&amp;P Global common stock (&quot;S&amp;P Global RSUs&quot; and &quot;S&amp;P Global PSUs&quot;, as applicable) were equitably adjusted and converted into restricted stock units with respect to Issuer common stock(&quot;Mobility RSUs&quot;), based on the quotient of (i) the one-day volume weighted average price (&quot;VWAP&quot;) of S&amp;P Global common stock on June 30, 2026 and (ii) the one-day VWAP of Issuer common stock on July 1, 2026 (such adjustment, the &quot;Equity Award Conversion&quot;).</footnote> <footnote id="F3">Represents the grant of Mobility RSUs upon the conversion of S&amp;P Global RSUs held by the Reporting Person as of immediately prior to the Spin-Off pursuant to the Equity Award Conversion. The Mobility RSUs are subject to vesting as follows: (i) 133,306 are scheduled to vest in substantially equal installments on each of March 1, 2027, March 1, 2028 and March 1, 2029, and (ii) 137,900 are scheduled to vest in substantially equal installments on each of March 1, 2027, March 1, 2028 and March 1, 2029, in each case, subject to the terms of each applicable S&amp;P Global award agreement.</footnote> </footnotes> <ownerSignature> <signatureName>/s/ Taptesh (Tasha) K. id="F1">Relates to the spin-off of MSG Rangers Corp. (formerly MSGS Spinco, Inc., and referred to herein as &quot;MSGR&quot;) from MSG Knickerbockers Corp. (formerly Madison Square Garden Sports Corp., and referred to herein as &quot;MSGK&quot;). To effect the spin-off, on October 20, 2026, the issued and outstanding common stock of MSGR was recapitalized into MSGR's Class A common stock (&quot;Class A Common Stock&quot;) and MSGR's Class B common stock (&quot;Class B Common Stock&quot;) in a transaction exempt under Rule 16b-7. On October 26, 2026, MSGK distributed one share of Class A Common Stock and Class B Common Stock to its stockholders for every two shares of MSGK Class A common stock and MSGK Class B common stock, respectively (the &quot;Distribution&quot;), in a transaction exempt under Rule 16a-9.</footnote> <footnote id="F2">Represents Class A Common Stock received in connection with the Distribution in a transaction exempt under Rules 16a-9 and 16b-3.</footnote> <footnote id="F3">Reflects a transfer of shares previously owned directly by MSGK and its subsidiaries exempt under Rule 16a-13.</footnote> <footnote id="F4">Represents Class A Common Stock received in connection with the Distribution pursuant to vested MSGK restricted stock units (&quot;RSUs&quot;), in a transaction exempt under Rules 16a-9 and 16b-3. The shares of Class A Common Stock were granted pursuant to the MSGR 2026 Stock Plan for Non-Employee Directors. Reporting Person received one share of Class A Common Stock in respect of every two vested MSGK RSUs.</footnote> <footnote id="F5">Class B Common Stock is convertible at the option of the holder on a share for share basis into Class A Common Stock.</footnote> </footnotes> <ownerSignature> <signatureName>/s/ Thomas C. Dolan</signatureName> <signatureDate>2026-10-28</signatureDate> </ownerSignature> </ownershipDocument>

id="F1">Relates to the spin-off of MSG Rangers Corp. (formerly MSGS Spinco, Inc., and referred to herein as &quot;MSGR&quot;) from MSG Knickerbockers Corp. (formerly Madison Square Garden Sports Corp., and referred to herein as &quot;MSGK&quot;). To effect the spin-off, on October 20, 2026, the issued and outstanding common stock of MSGR was recapitalized into MSGR's Class A common stock (&quot;Class A Common Stock&quot;) and MSGR's Class B common stock (&quot;Class B Common Stock&quot;) in a transaction exempt under Rule 16b-7. On October 26, 2026, MSGK distributed one share of Class A Common Stock and Class B Common Stock to its stockholders for every two shares of MSGK Class A common stock and MSGK Class B common stock, respectively (the &quot;Distribution&quot;), in a transaction exempt under Rule 16a-9.</footnote> <footnote id="F2">Represents Class A Common Stock received in connection with the Distribution in a transaction exempt under Rule 16a-9.</footnote> <footnote id="F3">Reflects a transfer of shares previously owned directly by MSGK and its subsidiaries exempt under Rule 16a-13.</footnote> <footnote id="F4">Includes 158 shares held jointly with spouse.</footnote> <footnote id="F5">Reporting Person disclaims beneficial ownership of these securities and this report shall not be deemed to be an admission that he is, for the purposes of Section 16 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended, or for any other purpose, the beneficial owner of such securities.</footnote> <footnote id="F6">Securities held by Reporting Person and Reporting Person's spouse as custodians for minor children.</footnote> <footnote id="F7">Class B Common Stock is convertible at the option of the holder on a share for share basis into Class A Common Stock.</footnote> </footnotes> <ownerSignature> <signatureName>/s/ Brian G. Sweeney, Attorney-in-Fact for Matthew J. Dolan</signatureName> <signatureDate>2026-10-28</signatureDate> </ownerSignature> </ownershipDocument>

</ownershipNature> </derivativeTransaction> </derivativeTable> <footnotes> <footnote id="F1">Relates to the spin-off of MSG Rangers Corp. (formerly MSGS Spinco, Inc., and referred to herein as &quot;MSGR&quot;) from MSG Knickerbockers Corp. (formerly Madison Square Garden Sports Corp., and referred to herein as &quot;MSGK&quot;). To effect the spin-off, on October 20, 2026, the issued and outstanding common stock of MSGR was recapitalized into MSGR's Class A common stock (&quot;Class A Common Stock&quot;) and MSGR's Class B common stock (&quot;Class B Common Stock&quot;) in a transaction exempt under Rule 16b-7. On October 26, 2026, MSGK distributed one share of Class A Common Stock and Class B Common Stock to its stockholders for every two shares of MSGK Class A common stock and MSGK Class B common stock, respectively (the &quot;Distribution&quot;), in a transaction exempt under Rule 16a-9.</footnote> <footnote id="F2">Represents Class A Common Stock received in connection with the Distribution in a transaction exempt under Rule 16a-9.</footnote> <footnote id="F3">Reflects a transfer of shares previously owned directly by MSGK and its subsidiaries exempt under Rule 16a-13.</footnote> <footnote id="F4">These securities are owned solely by the Charles F. Dolan Children Trust FBO James L. Dolan, which is a member of a &quot;group&quot; with the other Reporting Persons for purposes of Section 13(d) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the &quot;Exchange Act&quot;). Each of the other Reporting Persons disclaim beneficial ownership of these securities and this report shall not be deemed to be an admission that the other Reporting Persons are the beneficial owners of such securities for purposes of Section 16 of the Exchange Act or for any other purpose.</footnote> <footnote id="F5">These securities are owned solely by the Charles F. In the Distribution, MSGK distributed one share of MSGR's Class A common stock (&quot;Class A Common Stock&quot;) and one share of MSGR's Class B common stock to MSGK stockholders for every two shares of MSGK Class A common stock and MSGK Class B common stock, respectively, in a transaction exempt under Rule 16a-9.</footnote> <footnote id="F2">Represents Class A Common Stock received by the Reporting Person in connection with the Distribution pursuant to vested MSGK restricted stock units (&quot;RSUs&quot;), in a transaction exempt under Rules 16a-9 and 16b-3. The shares of Class A Common Stock were granted pursuant to the MSGR 2026 Stock Plan for Non-Employee Directors. Reporting Person received one share of Class A Common Stock in respect of every two vested MSGK RSUs.</footnote> <footnote id="F3">Each RSU is granted under the MSGR 2026 Employee Stock Plan and represents the right to receive one share of Class A Common Stock or the cash equivalent thereof.</footnote> <footnote id="F4">Reflects the acquisition of RSUs in connection with the Distribution in a transaction exempt under Rules 16a-9, 16b-6 and 16b-3. Reporting Person received one MSGR RSU in respect of every two unvested MSGK RSUs.</footnote> <footnote id="F5">Pursuant to the terms of Reporting Person's MSGK RSU award dated August 29, 2024, the RSUs are scheduled to vest and settle on September 15, 2027.</footnote> </footnotes> <ownerSignature> <signatureName>/s/ Mark C. id="F1">Relates to the spin-off of MSG Rangers Corp. (formerly MSGS Spinco, Inc., and referred to herein as &quot;MSGR&quot;) from MSG Knickerbockers Corp. (formerly Madison Square Garden Sports Corp., and referred to herein as &quot;MSGK&quot;). To effect the spin-off, on October 20, 2026, the issued and outstanding common stock of MSGR was recapitalized into MSGR's Class A common stock (&quot;Class A Common Stock&quot;) and MSGR's Class B common stock (&quot;Class B Common Stock&quot;) in a transaction exempt under Rule 16b-7. On October 26, 2026, MSGK distributed one share of Class A Common Stock and Class B Common Stock to its stockholders for every two shares of MSGK Class A common stock and MSGK Class B common stock, respectively (the &quot;Distribution&quot;), in a transaction exempt under Rule 16a-9.</footnote> <footnote id="F2">Represents Class A Common Stock received in connection with the Distribution in a transaction exempt under Rules 16a-9 and 16b-3.</footnote> <footnote id="F3">Reflects a transfer of shares previously owned directly by MSGK and its subsidiaries exempt under Rule 16a-13.</footnote> <footnote id="F4">Represents Class A Common Stock received in connection with the Distribution pursuant to vested MSGK restricted stock units (&quot;RSUs&quot;), in a transaction exempt under Rules 16a-9 and 16b-3. The shares of Class A Common Stock were granted pursuant to the MSGR 2026 Stock Plan for Non-Employee Directors. Reporting Person received one share of Class A Common Stock in respect of every two vested MSGK RSUs.</footnote> <footnote id="F5">Class B Common Stock is convertible at the option of the holder on a share for share basis into Class A Common Stock.</footnote> </footnotes> <ownerSignature> <signatureName>/s/ Richard Baccari, Attorney-in-Fact for Marianne Dolan Weber</signatureName> <signatureDate>2026-10-28</signatureDate> </ownerSignature> </ownershipDocument>

</derivativeTransaction> </derivativeTable> <footnotes> <footnote id="F1">Relates to the spin-off of MSG Rangers Corp. (formerly MSGS Spinco, Inc., and referred to herein as &quot;MSGR&quot;) from MSG Knickerbockers Corp. (formerly Madison Square Garden Sports Corp., and referred to herein as &quot;MSGK&quot;). To effect the spin-off, on October 20, 2026, the issued and outstanding common stock of MSGR was recapitalized into MSGR's Class A common stock (&quot;Class A Common Stock&quot;) and MSGR's Class B common stock (&quot;Class B Common Stock&quot;) in a transaction exempt under Rule 16b-7. On October 26, 2026, MSGK distributed one share of Class A Common Stock and Class B Common Stock to its stockholders for every two shares of MSGK Class A common stock and MSGK Class B common stock, respectively (the &quot;Distribution&quot;), in a transaction exempt under Rule 16a-9.</footnote> <footnote id="F2">Represents Class A Common Stock received in connection with the Distribution in a transaction exempt under Rules 16a-9 and 16b-3.</footnote> <footnote id="F3">Includes 208 shares held jointly with spouse.</footnote> <footnote id="F4">Reflects a transfer of shares previously owned directly by MSGK and its subsidiaries exempt under Rule 16a-13.</footnote> <footnote id="F5">Represents Class A Common Stock received in connection with the Distribution in a transaction exempt under Rule 16a-9.</footnote> <footnote id="F6">Securities held directly by Reporting Person's spouse and indirectly by Reporting Person.</footnote> <footnote id="F7">Reporting Person disclaims beneficial ownership of these securities and this report shall not be deemed to be an admission that he is, for the purposes of Section 16 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended, or for any other purpose, the beneficial owner of such securities.</footnote> <footnote id="F8">Reporting Person disclaims beneficial ownership of all shares of MSGR beneficially owned or deemed to be beneficially owned by his minor children and household members, and this filing shall not be deemed an admission that Reporting Person is, for purposes of Section 16 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended, or for any other purpose, the beneficial owner of such securities.</footnote> <footnote id="F9">Class B Common Stock is convertible at the option of the holder on a share for share basis into Class A Common Stock.</footnote> <footnote id="F10">Represents Class B Common Stock received in connection with the Distribution in a transaction exempt under Rules 16a-9 and 16b-3.</footnote> <footnote id="F11">Each restricted stock unit (&quot;RSU&quot;) is granted under the MSGR 2026 Employee Stock Plan and represents a right to receive one share of Class A Common Stock or the cash equivalent thereof.</footnote> <footnote id="F12">Reflects the acquisition of RSUs in connection with the Distribution in a transaction exempt under Rules 16a-9, 16b-6 and 16b-3. Reporting Person received one MSGR RSU in respect of every two MSGK RSUs.</footnote> <footnote id="F13">Pursuant to the terms of Reporting Person's MSGK RSU award dated August 29, 2024, the RSUs are scheduled to vest and settle on September 15, 2027.</footnote> <footnote id="F14">Pursuant to the terms of Reporting Person's MSGK RSU awards dated August 21, 2025, the RSUs are scheduled to vest and settle in two equal installments on September 15, 2027 and September 15, 2028.</footnote> <footnote id="F15">Pursuant to the terms of Reporting Person's MSGK RSU award dated August 26, 2026, the RSUs are scheduled to vest and settle in three equal installments on September 15, 2027, September 15, 2028 and September 15, 2029.</footnote> </footnotes> <ownerSignature> <signatureName>/s/ James L.
